excerpt.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]的表面几乎完全被一些整齐排列的圆形小池塘覆盖。这种规整的网格表明它们可能是精心设计的而非自然形成。现场调查可能带来更多的解答。
excerpt.en: [from.Planet.GetName]'s surface is almost entirely covered by a lattice grid of small, circular, liquid-filled pools. Their neat alignment suggests deliberate engineering rather than natural formation. A field expedition may provide more answers.

texts.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的大部分地表变成了一列列精心排列的球形空洞。这些圆形的小盆地中填满了黏稠的毒液。

在其中一个池子里发现了一个破裂的有机囊体，表面覆盖着凝胶状的黏液。囊的外膜似乎是被从内部刺破的。

至于这个囊是否就是池中液体的来源仍有待研究。
texts.en:
Most of the surface of [from.Planet.GetName] has been worked into a series of spherical hollows arranged in carefully aligned rows. These small rounded basins are filled with a viscous toxic fluid.

Discovered within one of the pools was a ruptured organic sac coated in a gelatinous mucus. The sac's membrane appears to have been pierced from the inside.

Whether or not this sac is the source of the liquid inside the pools remains to be discovered.

texts.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的黏液池进行分析发现了异常的放射性生长激素，这通常与有机孕育周期有关。

囊的内层似乎是一层复杂的肉质膜，能够调节黏液渗透的速度。
texts.en:
Analysis of the slime pools on [from.Planet.GetName] identified unusually radioactive growth hormones commonly associated with organic gestation cycles.

The lining of the sac itself appears to be a sophisticated fleshy membrane, capable of regulating the rate at which the slime permeates through.

texts.zh: 这些颊囊和我们自己的繁育周期有这令人震惊的相似性，或许是某种我们的远亲物种。
texts.en: These pods bear a striking similarity to our own reproductive cycles and are perhaps some form of distantly related species.

texts.zh: 我们认为发现的是某种物种高度适应毒性环境的繁育颊囊。进一步探索可以带来更多的解答。
texts.en: We believe we have discovered the leftover gestation pods of a species with a particular adaptation to toxic environments. Further exploration should provide more answers.

texts.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的黏液池中发现的一个破裂的繁育囊含有一个几乎发育完全的生命形式。

显微分析表明，这个胚胎标本中存在复杂的神经系统，其神经特性通常意味着智慧生命。

最后一组黏液池还有待检验。
texts.en:
One of the ruptured gestation sacs found in the slime pools of [from.Planet.GetName] contained the remains of a nearly fully-developed lifeform.

Microscopic analysis of this embryonic specimen suggests the presence of a complex nervous system with neural qualities commonly associated with intelligent life.

One final array of pools remains to be examined.

label.en: Examine the last of the pools.

texts.zh:
在检测[from.Planet.GetName]上剩下的黏液池时，[leader.GetName]发现了一具完整的繁育囊，其中还探测到了生命信号。

然而在提取的过程中，颊囊的肉质薄膜发生了破裂，这具标本死去了。
texts.en:
While examining the remaining slime pools on [from.Planet.GetName], [leader.GetName] found a fully-intact gestational sac with life signs detected within.

However, during the extraction process the sac's fleshy membrane ruptured and the specimen perished.

texts.zh: 里面的小尸体呈现出不同寻常的生物特征，包括充满放射性血浆的血管和分泌精神活性化合物的内腺体。
texts.en: The small cadaver inside exhibited unusual biological features, including veins filled with radioactive plasma and internal glands that secrete psychoactive compounds.

texts.zh:
研究确定，包括胚胎在内的整个繁育囊都是通过向高能的有毒粘液中插入一种特殊的化学催化剂产生的。

我们认为找到了一个未知物种的废弃古繁殖地。这是它们生殖周期的正常组成还是人工设施，我们可能永远不得而知。通过在原位培养，我们也许能够再繁育出一个活体样本。
texts.en:
It has been determined that the entire gestational sac, including the embryonic creature within, was spawned within the toxic slime by inserting a specialized chemical catalyst into the energy-dense slime.

We believe we have found the abandoned ancient breeding grounds of an unknown species.Whether this was a normal part of their reproductive cycle or an artificial facility, we may never know. By incubating a sample in situ, we may be able to grow another living specimen.

texts.zh: 亦或者我们可以小剂量地将这些丰富而有效繁育黏液作为营养补充剂在[leader.Owner.GetName]各处发放。
texts.en: Alternatively, we could distribute small doses of this rich and potent gestational slime as a nutritional supplement across the [leader.Owner.GetName].

label.en: Extract the energy from this slime.

texts.zh: 通过催化一些从[from.Planet.GetName]取回的毒性繁育黏液，我们或许可以从中孵出生物体。
texts.en: By catalyzing some of the toxic gestational slime recovered from [from.Planet.GetName] we may be able to spawn a living organism from it.

texts.zh:
通过催化一份从[from.From.Planet.GetName]取回的毒性繁育黏液样品，我们得以诱导数十个含有胚胎的繁育囊孵化。

内部的生命体快速发育成熟后用特化的颚从内部刺穿了半透明的繁育囊膜。

它们看起来非常地温顺而乐于合作。
texts.en:
By catalyzing a sample of the gestational slime recovered from [from.From.Planet.GetName], we were able to induce the spawning of dozens of gestational sacs, each harboring an embryo.

When the rapidly developing organisms reached maturity, they pierced the translucent membranes of their gestational sacs from within using specially adapted mandibles. Slowly they emerged from the thick mucus, groggy and disoriented.

They appear to be docile and fully cooperative.

label.en: [Root.Owner.GetName] will find a purpose for them.

summary.text:
# 毒液池 / Toxic Pools

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/12_extreme_frontiers_arc_sites.txt:61；events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:2920 · DLC：脚本条件 has_shroud_dlc（Shroud 相关内容） script condition has_shroud_dlc · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求 has_shroud_dlc，权重+50，出现在有毒星球（pc_toxic）上。

When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs has_shroud_dlc and has weight +50 on toxic planets (pc_toxic).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

整齐排列的毒液池是一片孵化场；最后一枚完整的胎囊在提取时破裂，但剩下的黏液可以催化出一群新的生命。

1. 破裂粘液囊：破裂的粘液囊，被从内部刺破
2. 毒孕育池：毒液含放射性生长激素，与有机孕育周期相似
3. 胚胎残余：一枚几乎成形的胚胎，神经系统复杂
4. 发现生命信号：最后一枚胎囊在提取时破裂；三种处置

The neat lattice of toxic pools is a hatchery; the last intact sac ruptures on extraction, but the slime can be catalysed into new life.

1. Ruptured Slime Sac: a ruptured slime sac pierced from the inside
2. Toxic Gestation Pools: radioactive growth hormones typical of organic gestation
3. Embryonic Remains: an almost fully developed embryo with a complex nervous system
4. Life Signs Detected: the last sac ruptures during extraction; three ways forward

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 毒性黏液催化 / Toxic Slime Catalyzation：A：催化黏液（项目）→ extreme_frontiers.1120：孵出数十枚胎囊，成熟后得到温顺合作的“黏液生”族群（活体试验品科技进度25%、社会学研究） / A: catalyse the slime (project) → extreme_frontiers.1120: dozens of sacs hatch into docile, cooperative slimeborn pops (living-test-subjects tech progress 25%, society research)
- B：提取这些黏液的能量（能量、食物月度奖励）；C（特定帝国）：分发营养补充剂。 / B: extract the slime's energy (energy and food rewards); C (certain empires): distribute nutritional supplements.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 本遗址的 on_roll_failed 把事件池参数设为 no_events（不存在同名事件池），所以掷骰失败不会触发随机意外。 / The site passes RANDOM_EVENTS = no_events to its roll-failure effect (no pool of that name exists), so a failed roll triggers no incident.
